Small differences reported by I4R (SEs in cols 5-6: fixest/Stata .011/.009 vs printed .009/.008; adjusted R2 cols 2 and 5: .643/.811 vs printed .644/.812) arise only with alternative software (fixest, Stata reghdfe), not with the authors' lfe code, which reproduced the paper exactly.
